title: An empty Inactive tab says "No inactive terms"
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure all twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • Make sure no term is deactivated (every standard term is active and the shop has no inactive term of its own).
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The tab label shows a count of 0, and in place of the table the line "No inactive terms" shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-N2: “If the Inactive tab has no terms, it shows the line "No inactive terms" in place of the table, and its count reads 0.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Inactive tab is empty | "No inactive terms" | Inline line in place of the table”
  • S1-R3: “Below the header are two tabs, "Active" and "Inactive", each followed by a count of the terms in it. The page opens on Active.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
